report_topic: Public Health Infrastructure and Management of Health Services
observations_summary: The audit found significant deficiencies in public health infrastructure and management of health services in Bihar, including high vacancies (49%) in human resources, inadequate basic amenities and diagnostic services in healthcare facilities, and non-availability of essential drugs and equipment. Financial management was poor, with 31% budget savings and low health expenditure compared to national norms, while regulatory mechanisms were ineffective due to manpower shortages and delayed inspections.
